products.name: SIRUI 50mm F1.8 1.33x Anamorphic Lens (Super 35 / APS-C)
specs: Super 35 / APS-C and Micro Four Thirds (use crop mode on full frame)
f/1.8 to f/16, 10 blades, clickless ring
Sony E, Fujifilm X, Micro Four Thirds, Canon RF, L-Mount (chosen at checkout)
products.warranty: SIRUI limited warranty (SIRUI's warranty page lists 18 months for lenses)
products.returns: 30-day return policy on SIRUI's US store
products.summary: The lens that made anamorphic affordable: a Super 35 prime with f/1.8, a 1.33x squeeze and Schott glass, now priced far below every other new anamorphic lens. Reviewers found it sharp wide open, with minimal breathing and controlled blue flares.
products.fit: First anamorphic lens for a Sony FX30 or a6000-series, Fujifilm X, Panasonic Micro Four Thirds or Canon RF-S body, or a full-frame camera used in crop mode.
caveats: Covers Super 35 / APS-C only; on full frame you must use APS-C crop mode or you get dark corners.
Manual focus with no electronic contacts: no autofocus, no lens data in the file.
2.8 ft minimum focus; close-up filters work, extension tubes do not.
1.33x gives a subtle look: mild oval bokeh, no extreme squeeze. Pick a 1.6x lens if you want more.
Focus and iris markings are faint and there are no 0.8 mod gears in the box.

products.name: SIRUI Venus 50mm T2.9 1.6x Full-Frame Anamorphic Lens
specs: Manual, 0.8 mod gears on focus and iris
Sony E, Canon RF, L-Mount (Nikon Z at some retailers)
products.warranty: SIRUI limited warranty (SIRUI's warranty page lists 18 months for lenses)
products.returns: 30-day return policy on SIRUI's US store
products.summary: The cheapest new full-frame anamorphic lens we found. The 1.6x squeeze gives a much stronger anamorphic look than the 1.33x line, with low vignetting on full frame, at the cost of a heavy, long barrel.
products.fit: Full-frame Sony, Canon RF or L-Mount shooters who want a real anamorphic look on a tripod or a strong gimbal.
caveats: Heavy at 2.27 lb and long; not a run-and-gun lens.
1.6x is not in most cameras' de-squeeze menus (Sony FX3/FX30 have it on recent firmware; Panasonic offers 1.5x and 1.8x), so you may preview squeezed or use a monitor.
Reviewers note focus breathing and slight distortion, and a warm color cast.

products.name: SIRUI Astra 50mm T1.8 1.33x Full-Frame Autofocus Anamorphic Cine Lens
products.warranty: SIRUI limited warranty (SIRUI's warranty page lists 18 months for lenses)
products.returns: 30-day return policy on SIRUI's US store
products.summary: The first full-frame anamorphic lens with autofocus, and the cheapest one with AF on sale today. T1.8 is a stop faster than any rival, and 1.33x matches the de-squeeze preset in Sony, Panasonic and Fujifilm bodies.
products.fit: Solo shooters and gimbal users who need autofocus with the anamorphic look on a full-frame Sony, Nikon Z or L-Mount body.
caveats: Four times the price of the manual 50mm 1.33x.
1.33x is the mildest squeeze; the look is subtle.
No Canon RF or Fujifilm X version.
A new line (late 2025); long-term reliability reports are thin.
